title: Persuasive writing: one reader, one offer, one action

say: Persuasive writing: one reader, one offer, one action.
This is the video for module 1 of Copywriting for Sales.
Copywriting is writing that asks someone to do something: buy, order, book or message. If you sell anything, you are already a copywriter.

say: For example, Ngozi sells work bags in Onitsha. Her status said, quality bags available, DM for price. Who is it for? What bag? Why this one? It got views, but almost no messages.

panel.heading: Ngozi's bag status, before and after

say: She chose one reader: a young woman starting her first office job. One offer: a black tote that fits a 15-inch laptop, about 18,500 naira. One action: reply TOTE and she will hold one till 6pm.
Now the reader sees her own situation, the real price, and one easy thing to do.

panel.heading: Ngozi's bag status, before and after

say: People do not buy products. They buy a better situation. A pain point is her problem now: my children's school shoes tear before the term ends.

say: For example, Aisha makes unripe plantain flour in Kaduna. She reads 40 customer chats from the last two months.

panel.heading: Aisha's plantain flour headline
items: Reads 40 chats from two months
Pain: told to change swallow, misses it
Objections: bitter? pure? safe?
Opens with: Miss eating swallow?

say: The pain she sees most: people told by a doctor to change their swallow, who miss eating it with soup.

items: Reads 40 chats from two months

Objections: bitter? pure? safe?

say: The objections: will it taste bitter, is it really pure, and is it safe for a health condition?

panel.heading: Aisha's plantain flour headline
items: Reads 40 chats from two months
Pain: told to change swallow, misses it
Objections: bitter? pure? safe?
Opens with: Miss eating swallow?

say: Her new copy opens: Miss eating swallow? Only dried unripe plantain, nothing added. Smooth, not bitter, ready in 5 minutes.

say: And it ends: ask your doctor how it fits your meal plan. She handles the health question honestly, instead of making a claim she cannot prove.

panel.rule: Never make medical claims you cannot prove.

say: Voice is your brand's personality. It stays the same. Tone adjusts to the moment, the way you speak differently at a wedding and a condolence visit. For a promotion, a playful Pidgin hook can work, but keep prices and dates in clear words.

panel.heading: Same voice, different tone
right: What you will do about it

say: When something goes wrong, be serious. For example, Blessing's cakes in Port Harcourt were delayed by heavy rain. Not, sorry o, rain did us. Instead: I am very sorry, the rain delayed our driver, your cake is safe, and he will reach you by 4:30pm.

panel.heading: Same voice, different tone
right: What you will do about it

say: AIDA stands for Attention, Interest, Desire and Action. For example, Halima, a tailor in Kano. Attention: Sallah is in 3 weeks. Is your kaftan ready?

panel.heading: AIDA: Halima's kaftan message
items: Attention: Sallah is in 3 weeks
Interest: kaftans sewn in 5 days
Desire: neat embroidery, sized to fit
Action: send measurements, word KAFTAN

say: Interest: we sew men's kaftans in 5 days, using cotton that does not shrink.

panel.heading: AIDA: Halima's kaftan message
items: Attention: Sallah is in 3 weeks
Interest: kaftans sewn in 5 days
Desire: neat embroidery, sized to fit
Action: send measurements, word KAFTAN

say: Desire: neat embroidery, sized to fit, so you look sharp at Eid prayers. See last year's orders in my catalogue.

panel.heading: AIDA: Halima's kaftan message
items: Attention: Sallah is in 3 weeks

say: Action: I can take 15 more orders before Sallah. Send your measurements on WhatsApp today. That limit is honest, because she can only sew so many in time.

say: A feature is a fact. A benefit is what it does for her. Rechargeable fan with a 12-hour battery, which means you sleep through the night when there is no light.

panel.heading: AIDA: Halima's kaftan message
items: Attention: Sallah is in 3 weeks
Interest: kaftans sewn in 5 days
Desire: neat embroidery, sized to fit
Action: send measurements, word KAFTAN
panel.rule: Use 'which means' to turn every feature into a benefit.

say: Social proof, scarcity and authority help buyers decide, when they are true. Share real reviews, a true stock limit, and your real experience.

panel.heading: Persuade, never manipulate
left: Your real training or NAFDAC number
right: Last few, every day for months

say: Fake reviews, fake countdowns, shaming and hidden costs destroy trust. And Nigeria's consumer protection law, enforced by the FCCPC, forbids false or misleading claims.
Ask yourself: would I be comfortable if the customer saw exactly why I wrote each line?

panel.heading: Persuade, never manipulate
left: Your real training or NAFDAC number
right: Last few, every day for months

say: To remember. One reader, one offer, one action. Ask so what of every sentence. Start with her pain, in her words. Keep your voice steady, and fit the tone to the moment. And only true claims.

panel.heading: Remember
items: One reader, one offer, one action

AIDA, benefits, and only true claims
